notes: CLI route: scripts/bugsee-sourcemaps.mjs runs bugsee-cli to inject debug ids into the built output and upload its source maps. The output directory defaults to ./dist (pass it as an argument or set BUGSEE_SOURCEMAPS_DIR); the app token comes from BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN or .env.bugsee-build-plugin. The rspack plugin does not upload yet (JS issue #184), so this recipe uses the bugsee-cli script until it lands. Enable devtool: "source-map" in the rspack config.
